crossRefs.note: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.
Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith, and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done…
For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him, but the tax collectors and the…
With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”
Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to…
Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

translations.web: Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
translations.bsb: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
translations.kjv: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
translations.asv: And why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
